name: ajc
description: Automatically select and load relevant available skills for complex Codex projects, with scoped execution, evidence-driven verification, and complete source materials.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically route complex projects to relevant skills.
interface.longDescription: AJC breaks complex projects into stages, selects and loads relevant skills from the current environment, and re-evaluates routes as work progresses. It coordinates scope, minimal changes, available capabilities, verification, and concise Chinese delivery. Complete source manuals and modular reference materials are included.
defaultPrompt: Use $ajc to automatically select and load the relevant available skills for this project.
Use $ajc to plan the smallest safe change and verify the result.
使用 $ajc 自动选择合适的技能，分阶段完成这个项目并验证结果。
